desc:
🧊 FREEZE TAG! Fast-paced freeze tag with a slippery twist!

🏃 Dodge freezers, rescue teammates, and survive until time runs out. Stay frozen too long and join the hunt!
💰 Earn Coins, level up, and unlock cool cosmetics!
🎁 Join the group for 50% BONUS XP!
👍 Don’t forget to like the game!
🎮 Works on Phone, Tablet, Computer, and Console!

✅USE CODE "RELEASE"
